causes.cause: Syntax error in template (missing closing tag, incorrect variable)

resolution.step: Run `hugo --verbose` to see detailed error messages.
Check the reported file and line number.
Validate front matter with a YAML/TOML linter.
Ensure all referenced layouts exist in `hugo/layouts/`.
Verify the asset path is correct relative to the static folder.
Check that the file exists and is committed.
Inspect the generated HTML to see the final asset URL.

causes.cause: Fixed widths used instead of fluid units

resolution.step: Use browser developer tools to simulate mobile viewport.
Replace pixel widths with percentages, rem, or viewport units.
Test on real devices if possible.

causes.cause: Missing ARIA attributes or incorrect roles

resolution.step: Address each violation listed in the report.
Use color contrast checkers to adjust foreground/background colors.
Add appropriate alt text to all images.
Ensure interactive elements have keyboard support.

prevention.guideline: Always run a local Hugo build before committing changes.
Use automated tools (Lighthouse, axe) as part of the validation step.
Follow the established patterns in existing layouts to avoid common mistakes.
Keep assets optimized and minified to reduce performance issues.

escalation.scenario: If an error cannot be resolved after following the above steps, consider:

actions.action: Check the Hugo documentation for the specific version being used.
Search the repository for similar issues or ask the user for clarification.
If the issue is outside the website scope (e.g., compiler integration), hand off to the appropriate mode.
